description: Evaluate a caller-supplied panel of 1-10 named fact profiles for one exact product against one serving snapshot, deduplicating reachable institutions and exact offers. This is descriptive only for the supplied panel: never call it a population estimate, conversion rate, approval forecast, or negative eligibility result. Use neutral profile labels instead of names, emails, account numbers, or other direct identifiers. Profiles are forwarded transiently and are not stored by this tool; unknown remains unknown.

limit.description: Maximum aggregate institutions and deduplicated offers returned.

product.description: Exact product request used for both eligibility-backed rate evaluation and ranking.

amount.description: Loan or credit amount in USD.

profiles.description: Caller-supplied named panel. Names must be unique within this request.

name.description: Unique neutral panel label, such as profile-01; do not put PII here.

person.description: Explicit caller-supplied person facts. Unknown facts stay absent; do not infer them.

applicant_kind.description: What the applicant is; absence means a natural person.

asserted_org_qualifiers.description: Narrow conditions the person explicitly asserted; never infer them.

association_org_ids.description: Explicit association ids returned by resolve_eligibility_entities; rates-api revalidates them.

associations.description: Associations the person already belongs to.

employer.description: Person-supplied employer name; use employer_org_ids after authoritative resolution.

employer_org_ids.description: Explicit employer ids returned by resolve_eligibility_entities; rates-api revalidates type and active-publication authority.

facility_county.description: County where the applicant organization maintains a facility.

facility_zip.description: ZIP where the applicant organization maintains a facility.

family_relation.description: Relationship to the relative whose affiliations are supplied.

home_zip.description: Home ZIP; never inferred from another role.

military_service_state.description: State tied to a state-scoped military affiliation.

payroll_zip.description: Payroll-origin ZIP, separate from the worksite.

property_city.description: Census-recognized city where the person owns real property.

property_county.description: County where the person owns real property.

property_zip.description: ZIP where the person owns real property; never inferred from home.

relative_association_org_ids.description: Canonical association ids belonging to the named relative, not the applicant.

relative_associations.description: Associations of the named relative, not the applicant.

relative_employer_org_ids.description: Canonical employer ids belonging to the named relative, not the applicant.

relative_employers.description: Employers of the named relative, not the applicant.

relative_memberships.description: Confirmed relative memberships, each scoped to one exact institution.

relative_school_org_ids.description: Canonical school ids belonging to the named relative, not the applicant.

relative_schools.description: Schools of the named relative, not the applicant.

school.description: Person-supplied school name; school_relationship is needed for a typed positive path.

school_org_ids.description: Explicit school ids returned by resolve_eligibility_entities; rates-api revalidates them.

school_relationship.description: How the person relates to the supplied school.

willing_to_join_association.description: Whether documented joinable-association actions may be considered.

work_zip.description: Worksite ZIP, separate from home and payroll.

worship_org_ids.description: Explicit worship-organization ids returned by resolve_eligibility_entities; rates-api revalidates them.

name: evaluate_eligibility_cohort

outputSchema.description: One-snapshot evaluation of a small caller-supplied panel.

aggregate.description: Deduplicated reachable institutions and exact offers, profile reach, counts, and truncation flags.

disclosure.description: Required warning that the panel is not a population estimate, conversion rate, approval forecast, or rejection.

methodology.description: Panel size/source, deduplication identities, and explicit no-extrapolation/no-conversion semantics.

product.description: Exact product request evaluated for the panel.

profiles.description: Per-profile counts, best evidenced offer, and observation timestamp.

snapshot.description: Shared rules clock and database observation boundaries.
